'''Yem Nemnin''' was a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. He was known for his unique method of killing his victims, by using his own [[Antiox breath mask/Legends|antiox breath mask]] to [[Poison/Legends|poison]] them to [[Death/Legends|death]].
